scientific_choices.choice: The paper uses segmentation components for localization and DeepSolo for fallback, not YOLO word slots. This experiment is outside STRICT mode.
Reuse frozen Total-Text TEST PARSeq crop readings, GT-blind slot assignment and local normalized-word bbox metric from the independent DeepSolo diagnostic.
Use a published YOLOv8s object detector trained on TextOCR word boxes as a lightweight transfer candidate. Its TextOCR validation mAP is not a Total-Text or word-selection result.
Use 640-pixel input, 0.05 recall-oriented inference floor, default-like NMS IoU 0.7 and 300 maximum detections. Evaluate prespecified score and crop-slot IoU controls without choosing from TEST.
Use the checkpoint-embedded Ultralytics 8.1.0 version for loading and send the original raster as BGR NumPy pixels, matching that version's documented BGR-to-RGB preprocessing.
Transfer from the published TextOCR checkpoint to Total-Text, single-character recall, and 8 GB RTX 3070 runtime remain unmeasured until a genuine GPU run.
